# Oracle Fact Sheet: Stargate Data Centers (Rep. Brett Hedges, 2025-09-23)

Congressional fact sheet on the Oracle–OpenAI Stargate commitment.

## Key findings
- **Abilene, Texas** — flagship Stargate site, "already up and running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)." 8 buildings on 1,100 acres, up to ~4M sq ft. Partner: Crusoe. Connects to the **ERCOT grid**; "Advanced natural gas turbines from GE Vernova will deliver uninterrupted reliability and support grid stability. Ultimately, this plant will be used for backup power." ~1,700 ongoing onsite jobs.
- **Shackelford County, Texas** — 10 buildings on 700 acres, 3.7M sq ft. Partners: Vantage Data Centers, VoltaGrid. "Powered by an onsite, behind-the-meter, **gas-powered microgrid utilizing Jenbacher reciprocating engines**."
- **Doña Ana County, New Mexico** — new site (announced Sep 2025).
- **Midwest site** — additional new site (location not named in this fact sheet).
- Potential additional 600 MW expansion near Abilene. Three new sites + Abilene + expansion = over 5.5 GW capacity, 4,800+ acres, 25,000+ onsite jobs.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — official fact sheet from a U.S. House Representative's office (primary government source).
- Names the **four Stargate data-center locations** (Abilene TX, Shackelford County TX, Doña Ana County NM, Midwest) and confirms Abilene is the flagship OCI Supercluster campus.
- Confirms **natural gas** is the backup/onsite power source at both Abilene (GE Vernova turbines) and Shackelford (Jenbacher reciprocating engines).
